How It Works

Three steps. Done.

No discovery phases, no six-week timelines, no surprise invoices. Order, review your draft, launch within days.

Step 1

Tell us about your business

Fill out a short form or hop on a quick call. Send your logo, photos, and services — or just point us at your Facebook page and we'll pull what we need.

Step 2

Review your draft site

We send a private link to your finished draft. Love it? Say the word and we go live. Want changes? You get 3 design revisions — each revision adds a couple of days to the build.

Step 3

Your site goes live

We connect your domain, set up your contact form, and hand you the keys. Customers can find you, call you, and reach you — fast.

How the clock works: your build timer starts only after we receive your signed service agreement, initial payment, completed intake form, and all required materials. From that point it runs based on your package — 48 hours, 1 week, or 10 days. It pauses whenever the draft is in your hands and resumes when you respond. Each revision round adds a couple of days. You're never rushed.

What's Included

Everything a small business actually needs.

No bloated plugins. No page builders that break. Every plan below is a fast, secure static site that does its job: getting customers to contact you.

  • Up to 7 professionally designed static pages
  • Contact form delivered straight to your email
  • Click-to-call buttons and Google Maps
  • Photo galleries, service lists, and reviews
  • Mobile-ready and fast on every connection
  • Google-friendly structure so customers find you

Why so fast?

We build static websites — the same modern approach used by top tech companies. No website database to maintain, no plugins to update, nothing extra to slow it down.

Fast

Static sites are built for speed. They load quickly on most connections and devices — and Google tends to rank faster sites higher than slower ones.
